description:
:

India is among the top ten priority markets for General Mills, and hosts our Global Shared Services Centre. This is the Global Shared Services arm of General Mills Inc., which supports its operations worldwide. With over 1,300 employees in Mumbai, the center has capabilities in the areas of Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Digital and Technology, Sales Capabilities, Consumer Insights, ITQ (R\&D \& Quality), and Enterprise Business Services. Learning and capacity\-building is a key ingredient of our success.
Job Description:
**Position Title**  

Manager \- Deployment, Service and Replenishment **Function/Group**  

Logistics **Location**  

Mumbai **Shift Timing**  

3\.30 pm to 12\.30 am **Role Reports to**  

Sr Manager \- Deployment, Replenishment and Service **Remote/Hybrid/in\-Office**  

Hybrid: Currently 2 days in a week but need to adhere if it changes in future. Over and above days defined in hybrid, need to be in office for additional days as per business requirements.

 **About General Mills** **We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents.** With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Häagen\-Dazs, we’ve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting). Each of our brands has a unique story to tell.
How we make our food is as important as the food we make. Our values are baked into our legacy and continue to accelerate
us into the future as an innovative force for good. General Mills was founded in 1866 when Cadwallader Washburn boldly bought the largest flour mill west of the Mississippi. That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com  

General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people.
With our team of 1800\+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital \& Technology (D\&T) Innovation, Technology \& Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy \& Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance Shared Services (FSS) and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in
We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow. **Job Overview** **Function Overview**  

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end\-to\-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well\-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. Link **Purpose of the role**  

General Mills India team virtually caters to multiple plants, warehouses, and several business teams / groups in US. The primary role will include people management, service management along with replenishment \& network management responsibilities.
* The incumbent will drive collaboration between Distribution, Supply, demand planning, and System governance teams to achieve functional/organizational targets.
* The objective of this role is to drive efficiencies in case\-fill while balancing cost and operational constraints.
* Lead and develop a team of distribution planners to achieve organizational goals.
* Support short\-term replenishment strategies in collaboration with US replenishment managers.
* The Manager will collaborate with other planning teams (Demand/Supply) to proactively call\-out service risks and minimize the impact on overall case\-fill targets.

**Key Accountabilities** **Strategic responsibilities*** Ensure smooth supply chain distribution planning of finished goods for the assigned Operating Unit/s by meeting and exceeding KPI metrics (ex\-Case fill rates) while optimizing overall SCM costs (transportation/inventory $).
* Accountable for tactical deployment decision\-making for assigned OU and Deployment Process Governance.
* Acts as a Regional Replenishment lead supporting US Replenishment Managers in the creation and execution of short\-term execution of network strategies identified.
* Support Deployers and Network SPOCs in problem\-solving and decision\-making related to operational and network constraints (Transportation, Warehouse, Plant Outbound, and Network space)

**Operational Responsibilities*** Develop knowledge and expertise in General Mills planning systems (SAP R/3, OMP, Inventory Analyst, Terra DS etc.)
* Provide regular communication updates on key performance metrics (case fill goals, service issues, inventory targets, warehouse/transportation constraints etc.) to the business stakeholders.
* Collaborate across supply chain teams (DP, scheduling, Customer service, warehousing, transportation, plants etc.) to identify and implement information and product flow improvements driving better Service for the OU
* Ensure execution as per standard processes and documentation.
* Utilize Continuous Improvement (CI) tools to drive process improvements.
* Actively participate in Staff meetings, Knowledge sharing sessions, Trainings, Collaboration meetings etc.
* Accountable for Distribution Planning Systems/Tools (OMP/Tableau dashboard/ERP) utilization sustainability
* Drive Run, Improve, and Transform methodologies.

**Projects*** Work on cross functional projects
* Lead organization/Function level initiatives to drive efficiencies and cost savings.
* Participate and contribute to Goal/ objective setting process for the fiscal year.

**Continuous Improvement:*** Build Architectural solutions through Automation, Standardization, Lean approach etc.
* Build sustainable and order winning solutions for the problems.
* Collaborate across with various team to implement defined solutions.
* Develop and implement repeatable and scalable models.
* Perform external competitive benchmarking and analysis.
* Lead Cost savings initiatives
* Lead ideation and drive implementation to deliver organizational goals.
* Develop sustainable tools for the capabilities.

**Continue Professional Career Development*** Participate in soft skills training driven by L\&D Team
* Leveraging Future skills \& Supply chain university platform to explore the emerging technologies \& enhance Supply chain skills.

**People Responsibilities*** Participate in developing goals and objectives for the Fiscal Year
* Energize and develop people by collaborating across boundaries.
* Train and Coach team members
* Complete annual performance management processes (annual objective setting, performance assessment and reviews, IDP, etc.)
* Hire, retain, and develop team members ensuring flawless execution of responsibilities without any disruption to the business.

**Organizational Effectiveness*** Identify collaboration opportunities across subgroups and beyond Deployment team.
* Share best practices / learnings with SME’s.
* Support development and Transition of new capabilities across Distribution planning organization.

**Minimum Qualifications*** Full Time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory)
* Related experience: Bachelors (8 years); MBA (6\+ years)
* Supply chain knowledge (Core Distribution Planning \& Logistic Operation, Basic logistic planning)
* Systems (SAP/OMP) understanding.
* Demonstrated Strong Project Management skills.
* Forward thinker and self\-motivator that thrives on new challenges and adapts quickly to learning new knowledge.
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strategic and Tactical decision making
* Critical Thinking and Analytical Skills
* Data Visualization and Storytelling
* Strong Stakeholder Management and Influencing Skills
* Strong analytical skills to draw inference and provide meaningful insights.
* Ability to translate Business information into actionable information.
* Excel and analysis skills (i.e., skilled at pivot table, charts / graphs, macros, solver, queries, mathematical functions etc.)
* Strong mathematical skills. Statistical skills will carry additional weightage.
* Exposure / experience of working with various\- ERP systems (OMP/SAP/O9\) and Supply Chain and Reporting tools (Inventory Analyst, Tableau etc.)
* Team Development
* Ability to benchmark / conduct external research for the capability and process.
* Ability to execute, multi\-task and deliver on commitments.
* Can prioritize and complete multiple tasks on tight deadlines.
* Coaching and Mentoring
* Ability to connect the dots and navigate through ambiguous situations.
* Excellent understanding of Supply Chain concepts, inventory management concepts and tools.
* Proven self\-management and time management skills.
* Excellent communication (verbal \& written) and presentation skills.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented approach along with ability to influence.
* Critical thinking ability to understand granularity of the situation / problem.
* Ability and agility to navigate through change.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Master’s degree
* 6\-7 years of related experience
* Major Area of Study in Supply Chain
* Preferred Professional Certifications: APICS – CSCP, PMP, Six Sigma

That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com  

General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people.
With our team of 1800\+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital \& Technology (D\&T) Innovation, Technology \& Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy \& Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance Shared Services (FSS) and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in
We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow. **Job Overview**
As an Anaplan Architect, you will be responsible for assisting in the design, development, and implementation of Anaplan solutions to meet the business needs of our organization. Your time will be spent solving complex problems at the intersection of three dynamic industries: Finance, Human Resources (HR), and Technology. You will work closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Anaplan models, including being a part of team ceremonies and supporting US\-based end users. You will also work very closely with our Finance, HR, D\&T, and legal teams to ensure we have the right integrations and data to implement into the models **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**  

Anaplan Platform Expertise:* Model Building: Advanced proficiency in Anaplan model building, including module design, list management, action creation, and data integration.
* Formula Optimization: Ability to write efficient and scalable formulas to handle complex workforce planning calculations.
* Data Integration: Experience with Anaplan Connect, APIs, and other integration methods to bring in data from HR systems, financial systems, and other relevant sources.
* Security and User Management: Understanding of Anaplan's security model and how to configure roles and permissions to ensure data integrity and appropriate access.
* Anaplan Certifications: Anaplan certifications (e.g., Anaplan Certified Model Builder, Anaplan Certified Solution Architect) validate expertise and are often required or preferred.


Workforce Planning Knowledge:* Workforce Planning Processes: Deep understanding of workforce planning methodologies, including demand forecasting, supply analysis, gap analysis, and scenario planning.
* HR Data: Familiarity with HR data structures, including employee demographics, compensation, performance, and skills data.
* Workforce Planning Metrics: Knowledge of key workforce planning metrics such as headcount, labor costs, turnover, and productivity.
* Industry Best Practices: Awareness of industry best practices for workforce planning and how to apply them within Anaplan.


Business Acumen:* Business Requirements Gathering: Ability to elicit and document business requirements from stakeholders across HR, Finance, and Operations.
* Process Analysis: Skill in analyzing existing workforce planning processes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Solution Design: Ability to translate business requirements into effective Anaplan solutions that meet the organization's needs.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.


Technical Skills:* Data Modelling: Strong data modelling skills to design efficient and scalable Anaplan models.
* ETL Processes: Experience with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to bring data into Anaplan from various sources.
* Scripting Languages: Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for advanced data manipulation and automation.
* Database Knowledge: Familiarity with database concepts and SQL for data extraction and analysis.

 **Project Management:*** Project Planning: Ability to create project plans, define tasks, and manage timelines.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile project management methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) for iterative development.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Change Management: Skill in managing change and ensuring user adoption of the Anaplan solution.

**Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills:*** Data Analysis: Ability to analyze large datasets and identify trends and insights.
* Problem Solving: Strong problem\-solving skills to troubleshoot issues and find creative solutions.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to think critically about business processes and identify areas for improvement.

**Communication and Collaboration:*** Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and team members.
* Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including HR, Finance, IT, and Operations.
* Training and Mentoring: Ability to train and mentor other Anaplan users and model builders.


Soft Skills:
Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing business needs and priorities.
Leadership: Leadership skills to guide and mentor other team members.
Time Management: Ability to manage time effectively and prioritize tasks.
Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**  

If they already have Anaplan experience:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related field.
* 6\+ years of relevant hands\-on Anaplan experience.
* Proficiency in Anaplan modeling techniques including lists, modules, dashboards, and worksheets.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Anaplan Certified Model Builder.
* 6\+ years of experience in workforce planning.
* Experience with SQL and GCP development.

description:
**About Target**  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means fostering a culture rooted in care, inclusion and respect, while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact. At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.

**Overview of Target in India**  

Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise\-wide strategy, technology and operations. Target in India offers an inclusive, learning\-focused environment where innovation, collaboration and people\-first values enable world\-class outcomes.

**About the Team**  

Target Human Resources is recognized for building strong, high\-performing teams that power the guest experience. We bring Target’s distinctive brand to life through continuous innovation, experimentation and evolution. Supporting nearly 400,000 team members across stores, distribution centers and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to leaders and team members alike. Our diverse community of people professionals works behind the scenes to cultivate a progressive culture of respect, reward, growth and opportunity.


Within Human Resources, Talent Acquisition plays a critical role in shaping Target’s future workforce. Recruiters lead the candidate journey end to end—from first engagement through onboarding and beyond—while acting as ambassadors for the Target employer brand. We tell a compelling story of what it truly means to work at Target and why it remains a destination employer in a competitive market.

**Role Overview**  

As a Senior Recruiter, you will design and execute talent acquisition strategies that attract, assess and hire top talent across assigned client groups. You will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR partners, leveraging market insights, data and relationships to deliver hiring outcomes aligned with business priorities. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, operational excellence and candidate\-centric execution, while continuously enhancing Target’s reputation as an employer of choice.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Lead full\-cycle recruitment for complex and critical roles, from intake through offer acceptance.
* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies using digital platforms, professional networks, referrals and direct outreach.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of diverse, high\-caliber talent for current and future needs.
* Partner closely with hiring leaders and HR partners to understand business objectives, identify talent gaps and recommend staffing solutions.
* Conduct behavioral\-based interviews and influence hiring decisions through thoughtful assessment and data\-backed insights.
* Extend, negotiate and close offers while maintaining fiscal responsibility and a positive candidate experience.
* Track and analyze recruiting metrics, including sourcing effectiveness, offer acceptance and time\-to\-fill, to drive continuous improvement.
* Act as a brand ambassador by authentically representing Target’s culture, values and career opportunities.
* Participate in external networking and professional organizations to strengthen market presence and talent connections.
* Lead or contribute to special projects that enhance recruiting capabilities, processes and innovation.

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the role; duties may evolve based on business needs.

**About You**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within product or enterprise organizations.
* Strong expertise in digital, social and data\-driven recruiting strategies.
* Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and influence stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Excellent communication, organization and attention to detail.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to balance creativity and execution in a fast\-paced environment.

* **Note:**


* Candidate having relevant experience from from travel and tourism or hotel industry would be considered.


**Salary slab:**


* Internship – Rs.120,000/\- Per annum (80:20 ration)
* Fresher – Rs.180,000/\- Per annum (80:20 ration)
* Experienced – Up to Rs.300,000/\- Per annum (80:20 ration)


**Education qualification:**


* Diploma / Graduate in Travel and tourism (any related certification)
* BBM – Bachelor of Business Management (not compulsory, but will be an added advantage)
* BBA – Bachelor of Business Administration (not compulsory, but will be an added advantage)
* BHM – Bachelor of Hotel Management (not compulsory, but will be an added advantage)


**Job Description:**



An administrative assistant in the hospitality industry plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of the business and providing support to management and staff. They must be organised, detail\-oriented, and able to multitask effectively in a fast\-paced environment. They should also possess excellent communication and customer service skills.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Perform general administrative duties such as answering phone calls, responding to emails, and managing calendars.
* Schedule appointments, meetings, and events for management and staff.
* Coordinate travel arrangements and accommodations for management, employees and guests.
* Assist with budgeting and financial management by processing invoices and tracking expenses.
* Manage and maintain files, records, and databases for the hospitality business.
* Assist with human resources tasks such as recruiting, onboarding, and maintaining personnel records.
* Create reports, presentations, and other documents for management and staff.
* Coordinate special projects, events, and promotions for the hospitality business.
* Provide exceptional customer service to guests and clients by answering questions, resolving complaints, and addressing concerns.
* Assist with marketing and social media efforts by managing accounts and creating content.
* Office management and supervising staff.
* Overseeing headship pupils working in the office.
* Welcoming guests, replying to the queries and directing them to suitable personnel.
* Managing telephone calls, supplying and getting data and directly talking to a suitable person.
* Keeping a check on the inventory of office materials and normal office supplies.
* Ensuring meetings are effectively organised and minute.
* Maintaining effective records and administration
* Upholding the legal requirements of company law
* Communication and correspondence
* Coordinate with top management.
* Maintain the consistency \& quality\-standards of company’s communication across different channels.
* Consistently brainstorming \& collaborating with team for new ideas \& strategies
* Review, edit, \& proof\-read content submitted by team members to ensure it is engaging, addressing buyer persona \& is grammatically \& factually\-correct.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**


**Key Skills:**


**Organisational Skills:** An administrative assistant must be able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and ensure deadlines are met.


**Communication Skills:** They must have excellent written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with guests, employees, and management.


**Customer Service Skills:** They must be able to handle clients inquiries and complaints in a professional and courteous manner, providing exceptional service to guests.


**Attention to Detail:** An administrative assistant must be detail\-oriented to ensure accuracy in records, reports, and other documentation.


**Time Management Skills:** They must be able to manage their time effectively and efficiently to meet deadlines and accomplish tasks within a fast\-paced environment.


**Interpersonal Skills:** They must have good interpersonal skills to work effectively with colleagues, guests, and management.


**Flexibility:** They must be adaptable to change and willing to take on new tasks and responsibilities as needed.


**Problem\-Solving Skills:** They must have the ability to identify problems and find solutions quickly and effectively.


**Teamwork Skills:** They must be able to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a positive work environment.


**IT Skills:**



IT skills are essential for an administrative assistant in the hospitality industry as technology plays a critical role in managing and operating various aspects of the business. Some of the IT skills required for an administrative assistant in the hospitality industry include:


**Technical Skills:** They must be proficient in using computer software such as Microsoft Office, database management systems, and other specialised software programs.


**Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite:** This includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, which are commonly used for managing reservations, creating reports, tracking expenses, and communicating with guests, colleagues, and management.


**Knowledge of Hospitality Management Systems:** Administrative assistants in the hospitality industry should have a basic understanding of property management systems, such as Opera, Fidelio, or Guestware, which are used to manage guest reservations, check\-ins, checkouts, room inventory, and other operations.


**Point\-of\-Sale Systems:** They should have knowledge of point\-of\-sale (POS) systems used in restaurants, bars, and retail stores to process transactions and manage inventory.


**Social Media Management:** An administrative assistant should have basic knowledge of social media platforms and tools such as Linkedin, Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram to manage social media accounts and create engaging content.


**Data Entry and Management:** They should have the ability to input, update, and manage data using database management systems such as Oracle, SQL, or Access.


**Online Booking and Payment Systems:** Knowledge of online booking platforms such as Booking.com, Expedia, or Airbnb, and payment systems such as PayPal or Stripe is also essential for an administrative assistant in the hospitality industry.


**Basic Networking:** Knowledge of basic networking concepts, such as LAN, WAN, and Wi\-Fi, can be helpful in troubleshooting network connectivity issues and ensuring a smooth operation of the IT infrastructure.



Overall, IT skills are essential for an administrative assistant in the hospitality industry to manage and operate the various aspects of the business efficiently and effectively.


**Core Skills:**


* Knowledge of general office procedures
* Ability to operate office equipment (fax, copier, mail, etc.)
* Customer service experience
* Ability to type at least 40 words per minute
* Proficient in proofreading, spelling, grammar punctuation and math
* Ability to learn new and updated software
* Positive attitude.
* Target oriented
* Presentable Personality


**Advanced Skills:**


* Knowledge of medical or legal terminology
* Proficient with tape transcription and ability to take shorthand
* Familiarity with File Site, a document management system


**Creative Skills:**


* Excellent verbal \& written communication skills.
* Excellent grasp of English language.
* Creative \& innovative thinker \& planner.


**Management Skills:**


* Ability to work both independently \& as an active member of a team.
* Able to prioritise, \& manage time efficiently.
* Managing different projects simultaneously \& working with strict deadlines.
* Self\-motivated \& self\-directed.


**Educational Requirements:**


**Bachelor’s Degree:** A Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, business administration, or a related field may be required for administrative assistant positions in larger hotel chains or corporate offices. This degree can provide more advanced knowledge in hospitality management, accounting, marketing, and other business skills.


**Professional Certifications:** Preferred administrative assistants to have professional certifications such as Certified Administrative Professional (CAP) or Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) to demonstrate their competency and knowledge in administrative and hospitality management.

The Union is a global membership, technical and scientific organisation. We were established in 1920 and are led by people who are committed to our vision, mission and values. Our members are organisations and individuals from all parts of the world. We are made up of government and non\-government agencies, charities, donors and funders, professional groups, patient groups and civil society organisations. We bring together clinicians, managers, policy makers, front\-line workers and implementers, scientists, patients and survivors, advocates and civil society.

**The Union’s Vision**: A healthier world for all, free of tuberculosis and lung disease

**The Union’s Mission**: The Union strives to end suffering due to tuberculosis and lung disease by advancing better prevention and care. We seek to achieve this by the generation, dissemination and implementation of knowledge into policy and practice. We aim to ensure that no\-one is left behind, people are treated equally and we have a focus on vulnerable and marginalised populations and communities.

**The Union’s Values:**

· **Quality**: we deliver our services and products to the highest possible standards.

· **Transparency**: we are open and direct in our dealings.

· **Accountability**: we are responsible stewards of resources, deliver on our commitments, and are accountable to our stakeholders.

· **Respect**: we recognise people’s intrinsic value and have due regard for the welfare, beliefs, perceptions, customs and cultural heritage of those we deal with.

· **Independence**: we seek to pursue our mission free from interference by conflicts of interest.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of people, purpose, and public health impact, supporting large\-scale programmes across India.

The selected candidate will play a key role in recruitment, contract management, HR administration, and field team coordination, while also contributing to strengthening HR systems, enabling teams, and ensuring seamless HR operations in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.

* Someone who thrives in a **fast\-paced, multicultural, and mission\-driven environment**.
* A team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a solution\-oriented mindset.

· 3 to 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in social impact/ development/INGO sector.

· Experience in recruitment, contract management, and HR operations for field\-based teams.

· Good understanding of labour laws and statutory compliance in India.

· Strong interpersonal, communication, and organisational skills.

· Proficiency in MS Office and HRIS systems.

description:
Ø Purpose of Position


* The Data Entry Operator \& Draftsman will support Bureau Veritas's Risk\-Based Inspection implementation for oil \& gas and refinery clients.
* This role combines technical data management with drafting capabilities to document inspection findings, create technical drawings, and maintain accurate RBI databases. The position is critical for ensuring data integrity, compliance documentation, and effective communication of inspection results to stakeholders.
* Co\-ordination with Client/ PMC/EPC for daily activities with respect to Field quality \& documentation.
* Ensure / Perform/ services in line with the End user / PMC/ EPC Quality Assurance System/ISO 17020 requirements, including the BV Code of Ethics and the BV Group policy


Ø Eligibility


Education

* Bachelor's degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Civil Engineering
* Or equivalent professional qualification recognized by Indian regulatory bodies


Experience \& Technical Skills

* Fresher/Minimum 1\-2 years in data entry, technical drafting, or inspection support roles
* Experience in oil \& gas, refineries, petrochemical, or pressure equipment industries
* Proficiency with CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, or equivalent)
* Experience with RBI databases or inspection management systems
* Familiarity with pressure equipment standards (ASME, PED, API)


Professional Attributes

* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English proficiency essential)
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
* Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Strong safety awareness and adherence to HSE protocols
* Project management and time management capabilities


Major Responsibilities


Data Entry \& Management

* Input inspection data, equipment specifications, and risk assessment information into RBI software systems and databases
* Maintain accurate records of inspection schedules, findings, and corrective actions
* Digitize hard\-copy inspection reports, equipment datasheets, and historical records
* Verify data accuracy and completeness, flag inconsistencies for review
* Update equipment registries, pressure equipment databases, and inspection tracking systems
* Manage document control and version tracking for RBI implementation deliverables

  

 Technical Drafting

* Create and modify technical drawings (P\&IDs, equipment layouts, inspection point diagrams)
* Prepare marked\-up drawings highlighting inspection locations, findings, and risk zones
* Generate visual reports and risk assessment diagrams for client presentations
* Maintain drawing standards compliance (ASME, ISO, API, client\-specific requirements)
* Coordinate with inspectors to accurately represent field findings in technical documentation

  

 RBI Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare inspection reports with data tables, charts, and visual summaries
* Compile risk matrices and inspection priority schedules
* Create equipment condition assessment summaries
* Support development of inspection strategies and frequency recommendations
* Assist in generating client deliverables and compliance documentation

  

 Technical Analysis \& Equipment Integrity


 Compliance \& Standards

*Ensure full compliance with:*

* Ensure all data entries comply with API 580, API 581, and ISO standards
* Perform quality checks on drawings and reports before submission
* Maintain confidentiality of client information and proprietary data
* Follow Bureau Veritas procedures, codes of conduct, and safety protocols
* Support audit trails and documentation requirements
* *Support Process Safety Management (PSM) and Mechanical Integrity programs*
* *Maintain comprehensive documentation and audit trails for regulatory inspections*


 Coordination \& Support

* Liaise with inspectors, engineers, and project managers for data clarification
* Respond to data requests and generate ad\-hoc reports as needed
* Participate in team meetings and training sessions
* Support software system administration and database maintenance


Ø Roles \& Responsibilities for HSE

* Must comply the BV Cardinal Safety Rules in all situations.
* To comply company HSE requirements e.g. policies, Procedures, guidelines etc. and local legal requirements on HSE as applicable
* To take care of own health and safety as well as colleagues and others.
* Immediate reporting of any shortcomings on HSE i.e. any incident, unsafe work practices / conditions to his/her immediate Line Managers.
* Sharing opportunities for improvement on HSE aspects.


Ø Criteria for Performance Evaluation (KPIs)

* Time taken to deliver report to the Client
* Quality of report
* Inspection done in allocated timeframe
* Client claims
* Detention ratio
* Customer satisfaction
* Share information, Best practise, Knowledge Management


The Job Description is subject to change from time to time, as per the requirements of the Company and the Competencies / qualifications you may acquire in future

* Maximum – 03 years experience as accountant from hotel industry.


* **Note:**

**Salary slab:**


* Fresher – Rs.180,000/\- Per annum (80:20 ration)
* Experienced – Up to Rs.300,000/\- Per annum (80:20 ration)


**Qualification:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA (Certified Public Accountant) or relevant accounting certification is often preferred.
* Prior accounting experience in the hospitality industry is a plus.
* Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
* Knowledge of industry\-specific regulations and tax laws.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.


**Job Description:**



The accountant in the hospitality industry plays a crucial role in managing financial operations, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring compliance with industry\-specific regulations. They are responsible for tracking revenue, expenses, and profit margins, providing financial insights to support decision\-making, and ensuring that the organisation’s financial activities run smoothly.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**


**Financial Recording and Reporting:**



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date financial records for the hospitality establishment.
* Prepare financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
* Generate regular financial reports for management and stakeholders.
* Monitor and report on key financial metrics, such as revenue, occupancy rates, and cost of goods sold.


**Budgeting and Forecasting:**


* Assist in the development of annual budgets and forecasts.
* Track actual financial performance against budgeted figures.
* Provide financial analysis to identify variances and recommend corrective actions.


**Accounts Payable and Receivable:**


* Process invoices, payments, and receipts accurately and in a timely manner.
* Reconcile accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure liquidity.


**Tax Compliance:**


+ Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal tax regulations.
+ Prepare and file tax returns, including goods and service tax, payroll, etc.
+ Stay updated on changes in tax laws that may impact the hospitality industry.



**Audit and Internal Controls:**


* Coordinate and participate in financial audits, both internal and external.
* Implement and maintain internal control procedures to safeguard financial assets and prevent fraud.


**Cost Control and Analysis:**


* Analyze cost structures, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and recommend cost\-control measures.
* Monitor and control expenses related to food and beverage, labor, and other operational areas.


**Financial Systems and Software:**


* Utilize accounting software and financial management systems to streamline processes and improve accuracy.
* Stay updated on advancements in accounting technology and recommend system upgrades when necessary.


**Financial Planning and Strategy:**


* Collaborate with management to develop financial strategies and long\-term financial plans.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business growth and profitability.


**Vendor and Supplier Relations:**


* Maintain relationships with vendors and suppliers, negotiate favorable terms, and ensure timely payments.


**Note:**



The specific duties and qualifications for an accountant in the hospitality industry may vary depending on the establishment’s size and specialisation, such as hotels, restaurants, resorts, or event venues. Additionally, the accountant may collaborate closely with other departments, such as operations, sales, and human resources, to achieve financial goals and objectives.



**Requirements \& Qualifications**


**Key Skills:**


**Organisational Skills:**


* Must be able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and ensure deadlines are met.


**Communication Skills:**


* They must have excellent written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with guests, employees, and management.


**Customer Service Skills:**


* They must be able to handle clients inquiries and complaints in a professional and courteous manner, providing exceptional service to guests.


**Attention to Detail:**


* Must be detail\-oriented to ensure accuracy in records, reports, and other documentation.


**Time Management Skills:**


* They must be able to manage their time effectively to meet deadlines and accomplish tasks within a fast\-paced environment.


**Interpersonal Skills:**


* They must have good interpersonal skills to work effectively with colleagues, guests, and management.


**Flexibility:**


* They must be adaptable to change and willing to take on new tasks and responsibilities as needed.


**Problem\-Solving Skills:**


* They must have the ability to identify problems and find solutions quickly and effectively.


**Teamwork Skills:**


* They must be able to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a positive work environment.


**IT Skills:**


**Technical Skills:**


* They must be proficient in using computer software such as Microsoft Office, database management systems, and other specialised software programs.


**Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite:**


* This includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, which are commonly used for managing reservations, creating reports, tracking expenses, and communicating with guests, colleagues, and management.


**Knowledge of Hospitality Management Systems:**


* Accountant in the hospitality industry should have a basic understanding of property management systems, such as Opera, Fidelio, or Guestware, which are used to manage guest reservations, check\-ins, checkouts, room inventory, and other operations.


**Point\-of\-Sale Systems:**


* They should have knowledge of point\-of\-sale (POS) systems used in restaurants, bars, and retail stores to process transactions and manage inventory.


**Data Entry and Management:**


* They should have the ability to input, update, and manage data using database management systems such as Oracle, SQL, or Access.


**Online Booking and Payment Systems:**


* Knowledge of online booking platforms such as Booking.com, Expedia, or Airbnb, and payment systems such as PayPal or Stripe is also essential for an accountant in the hospitality industry.


**Basic Networking:**


* Knowledge of basic networking concepts, such as LAN, WAN, and Wi\-Fi, can be helpful in troubleshooting network connectivity issues and ensuring a smooth operation of the IT infrastructure.


Overall, IT skills are essential for an accountant in the hospitality industry to manage and operate the various aspects of the business efficiently and effectively.


**Core Skills:**


* Knowledge of general office procedures
* Ability to operate office equipment (fax, copier, mail, etc.)
* Customer service experience
* Ability to type at least 40 words per minute
* Proficient in proofreading, spelling, grammar punctuation and math
* Ability to learn new and updated software
* Positive attitude.
* Target oriented
* Presentable Personality


**Advanced Skills:**


* Knowledge of medical or legal terminology
* Proficient with tape transcription and ability to take shorthand
* Familiarity with File Site, a document management system


**Creative Skills:**


* Excellent verbal \& written communication skills.
* Excellent grasp of English language.
* Creative \& innovative thinker \& planner.


**Management Skills:**


* Ability to work both independently \& as an active member of a team.
* Able to prioritise, \& manage time efficiently.
* Managing different projects simultaneously \& working with strict deadlines.
* Self\-motivated \& self\-directed.

description:
**Trainee Engineer**

  

Make your ability count at NNE


We are experts in end\-to\-end pharma engineering, and our success is built on our relationships, both with our colleagues and our customers. If you want to learn, adapt and get trained to work on projects shaping the future of sustainable and intelligent pharma facilities, NNE is the place to be. This training program is a six\-month course, and we are offering this Apprenticeship Program for engineering graduates who are passionate about pharma engineering.

**Why should you join us?**  

As a trainee engineer, you will embark on a comprehensive training program designed to equip you with the technical skills and industry knowledge essential for a successful career in pharmaceutical engineering. You will get better understanding about pharmaceutical manufacturing and compliance processes. You will also get to know about project execution.

**Location:** Bangalore, India  

**Experience:** 0\-6 Months  

**Department:** Pharma Engineering Talent Development  

**Duration:** 6 months

**How you might spend your days (Main Roles \& Responsibilities)**

As a trainee engineer in a pharmaceutical engineering consulting company, your days will be structured to provide you with a balanced mix of learning, hands\-on experience, and professional development.:

* Participate in training sessions on various technical aspects of pharmaceutical engineering.
* Be a part of an engaging learning environment, where you learn new ways of designing.
* Meeting your mentor/manager to discuss your progress, challenges, and learning experiences.
* Executing pilot projects in their respective areas


Who you are (Preferred Competencies)  

We care about who you are as a person. As an apprentice you are expected to:  

* Understand your colleagues and respect their varied cultural backgrounds
* Be a good listener and a creative thinker
* Stay curious
* Be proactive in creating an atmosphere of trust with colleagues
* Eager to learn and thrive in a dynamic work environment with highly skilled colleagues
* Excited to build on the NNE culture of innovation
* Implement the learning effectively in pilot project

  

**The miles you’ve walked (Education)**  

Below are these qualifications needed for you to do well in this role:* You have a degree in engineering (graduate / postgraduates) within


Biotechnology or pharmaceutical  

Chemical  

Mechanical / Mechatronics  

Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation  

Computer science  

Robotics \& automation

* You are fresher or having maximum up to six months of experiences
* You speak and write English


We’re experts bound by a noble cause and driven by passion  

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. Some of us are driven by working on highly complex projects together with other leading experts. Others are inspired by a work environment with flat hierarchy and flexible conditions. And some love the fact that they work for a world leading engineering consultancy within the pharma industry. If there's one thing, we all share, it's the passion for what we do. Together we design and build pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients all over the world.  

Sounds like something you’d like to do? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.  

  

Questions before applying? Please contact: hqer@nne.com  

  

Please note we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.  

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV.  

  

To facilitate an efficient and fair recruitment process, we encourage you to refrain from adding a photo in your CV. At NNE, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our applicants.


The invites for interviews will be on a recurring basis.  

  

To learn more about us visit www.nne.com

title: Technical Writer III
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Every day, our colleagues bring our Mission to life by empowering customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
   

  

 We are seeking a talented Technical Writer III to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is a pivotal role within a company at the forefront of scientific innovation, where your expertise will directly support the delivery of advanced bioscience solutions to customers worldwide. In this position, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and continuously improving high\-quality technical documentation for our industry\-leading bioscience products. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including R\&D, product management, quality, and regulatory, to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, accurate, and user\-focused content.
   

  

 If you are passionate about precision, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want your work to contribute to global scientific advancement, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with Thermo Fisher Scientific.
   

  

 REQUIREMENTS:
   

  

* Advanced degree in Bioscience, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of proven experience in technical writing, preferably within the bioscience or life sciences industry. Certification in technical writing is considered an asset.
* Experience with XML/DITA\-based authoring tools (e.g., Oxygen XML Editor/Author) and component content management systems (e.g., RWS Tridion Docs or similar) is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, concise documentation.
* Strong attention to detail with a demonstrated ability to produce accurate, high\-quality documents
* Familiarity with industry\-specific terminology and standards.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), Adobe Creative Suite, and other relevant software.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and subject matter experts.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet established deadlines.
* Willingness to complete required training and continuously update technical knowledge and skills

title: Jr. Software Engineer Intern (AI-Focused)
description:
**Company Description**  
Panva Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a leading provider of full\-stack technology development services, specializing in building innovative and tailored solutions that help businesses thrive in the digital era.

With deep expertise in both front\-end and back\-end development, PanvaTech creates scalable, user\-centric applications designed for seamless experiences.

We leverage cutting\-edge technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and agile methodologies to deliver end\-to\-end solutions—from concept to deployment—across industries such as Healthcare, LegalTech, FinTech, and EdTech.

For more information, visit www.panvatech.com or contact us at info@panvatech.com.

**Role Description**  
This is a full\-time, on\-site Jr. Software Engineer (Internship) role based in Vadodara.

As part of our global engineering team, you will gain hands\-on experience in AI\-driven software development while contributing to real\-world projects.

Selected candidates will undergo a structured **6\-month in\-person training program** focused on:

* Coding in the AI\-driven ecosystem
* Full\-stack development
* Building scalable applications
* Preparing for long\-term success in the evolving AI market

You will assist with software development tasks, contribute to back\-end system design, and support seamless integration across platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in software development, coding, debugging, and testing
* Contribute to the development and optimization of back\-end systems
* Support integration between various software components
* Work closely with cross\-functional and global teams
* Learn and apply AI in real\-world development scenarios
* Perform testing and stress testing of applications
* Support development and deployment across Web, iOS, and Android platforms
* Participate in the full product lifecycle—from development to deployment

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in:
* Computer Science
* Software Engineering
* MCA / BE or related field
* Basic to intermediate understanding of:
* Computer Science fundamentals
* Back\-End Web Development
* Software Development lifecycle
* Programming and Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines
* Familiarity with modern development tools is a plus

**Training \& Commitment**
